title: Lifetime Progression
author: Bhavin S.
desc: Unlock your potential with the "Lifetime Progression" program, an 18-week journey designed to elevate your strength and endurance. Committing to six days a week, you'll engage in a carefully structured regimen that progressively challenges your limits, ensuring consistent gains and preventing plateaus. Each week builds on the last, blending compound movements with targeted accessory work for a balanced approach. Embrace the challenge and watch as you transform your fitness journey into a lifetime of progress!
